# Stone Steps 50K and 27K Trail Run

> The public site for the Stone Steps 50K and 27K Trail Run, which the site calls Cincinnati's longest running ultra marathon: single-track loops through Mt. Airy Forest in Cincinnati, Ohio, run since 2003 and directed by David Corfman. The site carries the course, fee tiers and start times, all-time records, and a results archive for 2003 to 2025; registration is handled on RunSignUp.

Race details such as the date, fees, start times and entry caps are as published on the site and change each year, so check the pages below for current values.

## The race
- [Home](https://stonesteps50k.com/): Race date, the 50K and 27K side by side, fee tiers, start times, course summary, course records, race director
- [Course](https://stonesteps50k.com/course/): Loop order and distances, elevation, aid, cutoff, race-day weather history by year, what to bring, spectator notes
- [Contact](https://stonesteps50k.com/contact/): Message the race director, start location, answers to common questions

## Records and results
- [All-time records](https://stonesteps50k.com/records/): Course records, age-group records and fastest 10 on file for both distances
- [Results archive](https://stonesteps50k.com/results/): Winners and finisher counts for every running, 2003 to 2025
- [2025 results](https://stonesteps50k.com/results/2025/): Most recent year on file, every finisher with time
- [2003 results](https://stonesteps50k.com/results/2003/): The first running; each year from 2004 to 2024 has the same page at /results/YYYY/

## Elsewhere
- [Register on RunSignUp](https://runsignup.com/Race/OH/Cincinnati/StoneSteps50KTrailRun): Registration, linked from every page of the site
- [Full results on RunSignUp](https://runsignup.com/Race/Results/15282): The complete results archive, which the site says includes years it does not hold
- [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1103063513072311/): Trail conditions, carpools and race-week updates, as described on the site
- [Mt. Airy Forest, Cincinnati Parks](https://www.cincinnati-oh.gov/cincyparks/visit-a-park/find-a-parkfacility/mt-airy-forest/): The park the race runs in

## Optional
- [Privacy](https://stonesteps50k.com/privacy/): What the site collects, and how to have your name removed from the results pages
- [Full site content for LLMs](https://stonesteps50k.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded plain-text version of the pages above

## Contact
- Email: rd@stonesteps50k.com (the address the privacy page gives for questions and results removal)
- Location: Mt. Airy Forest, The Oval (Area 13), Cincinnati, Ohio
